hints.title: Baseline Reward Plus Upgrade Delta
hints.text: Every chosen task gives at least its base reward, and upgrading it yields a positive bonus equal to secondary minus primary.

hints.title: Sort by Base vs Upgrade
hints.text: Notice that upgrading is only beneficial if secondary[i] > primary[i].

hints.title: Select Top k Tasks
hints.text: Pair each task with its maximum possible gain and prioritize picking the top tasks while adhering to the bonus upgrade quota.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of k tasks and subsets of size at most limit is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting paired tasks requires O(n) extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects greedy decomposition into base value plus upgrade delta.
